---
title: "Details Demo"
---

## Example 1

This example shows the use of the `dtext` shortcode (or the `d_t` alias) to quickly create a details block containing text. The default summary text of "Details" is used.

### Syntax
`{{{< dtext "This is the collapsed text." >}}}`

### Output
{{< dtext "This is the collapsed text." >}}

## Example 2

This example shows the use of the `dtext` shortcode (or the `d_t` alias) to quickly create a details block containing text. The summary text is configured with an additional argument.

### Syntax
`{{{< dtext "This is the collapsed text." summary="Hint" >}}}`

### Output

{{< dtext "This is the collapsed text." summary="Hint" >}}

## Example 3

This examples shows the use of the `dopen` and `dclose` shortcodes (or the `d_o` and `d_c` aliases) to create a more flexible details block containing markdown as well as an executed code chunk.

### Syntax

````md
{{{< dopen summary="Answer Key" >}}}

**Here is some markdown**

```{{r}}
# And here is an R code chunk
plot(iris$Sepal.Length, iris$Sepal.Width)
```

{{{< dclose >}}}
````

### Output

{{< dopen summary="Answer Key" >}}

**Here is some markdown**

```{r}
# And here is an R code chunk
plot(iris$Sepal.Length, iris$Sepal.Width)
```

{{< dclose >}}
